events.title: US-Israel war on Iran: Strait of Hormuz blockade ongoing, two more ships attacked
events.summary: Iran has maintained blockade of Strait of Hormuz since Feb 2026. Reuters reports Hormuz shipping traffic fell to 6 vessels (Aug 11). US warned it will step up economic pressure (Aug 14). Two more ships attacked. Oil prices surging.

events.title: US Treasury executed first joint FX intervention with Japan since 1998 - unravelling
events.summary: US Treasury bought yen alongside Japan on July 31, 2026 - first such intervention since 1998. Used FIMA repo facility and executed in euros. Yen gains have unravelled back to ~159. 30Y Treasury yield at 5.24%, highest since 2007.

events.title: Yen approaching 160 again despite joint US-Japan intervention - BOJ pressured to hike rates
events.summary: Joint US-Japan intervention on July 31 unravelled. Yen back near 159-160. BOJ government said to support faster rate hike (Bloomberg). PM Takaichi approval rating hurt by rising prices. Next BOJ move likely Sep/Oct.

events.title: 2026 Ebola epidemic: 4,665 cases, 2,184 deaths - fastest growing outbreak on record
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC/Uganda. 4,665 confirmed cases, 2,184 deaths as of Aug 12. Declared public health emergency. Second largest Ebola outbreak in history. Existing treatments certified for Zaire species, not Bundibugyo.

events.title: Oil prices surge 5%+ on Hormuz stalemate - gold strengthens in tandem
events.summary: Hormuz talks stalled. Oil surged 5%+ in single session. EIA forecasts elevated oil prices until global flows normalize. Gold climbing as safe haven. 2026 Iran war fuel crisis creating economic divide in South America.

events.title: ECB set to hike rates to 2.5% in September - 83% of economists agree
events.summary: Reuters poll: 57 of 69 economists expect ECB to raise deposit rate by 25bps to 2.50% in September. Eurozone inflation rose to 2.9% in July, core to 2.5%. Middle East conflict pushing energy prices higher. Shortest tightening drive since 2011.

events.title: China racing to defuse $148B property time bomb as leases expire
events.summary: Bloomberg reports China facing $148B property threat. PBOC injected 349B yuan via overnight reverse repos - first mid-month operation of this kind. Deflation war faltering. Property sector crisis ongoing since 2020.

summary: 7 breaking events detected. 5 category-5 (severity 4+). Active war: Iran/US/Israel. Hormuz blocked. Ebola epidemic. US-Japan FX intervention unravelling. Oil surging. ECB rate hike incoming. China property crisis.
